log.msg: MECHANISM: /imagine/ is a columns host, so a screen cannot be a shell - it is the width word `full`, which folds the rail and the index into the crumb strip. One rule in screens.css re-tunes full's three tokens to fill's arithmetic, so a full screen can also SHARE the row. That single rule is the whole progressive division.

VERDICT divide (horizontal, add): 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 columns, measured 1920/960/640/480 at 1920 and 3440/1720/1147/860 at 3440. Nothing re-renders - the screens already open just take a smaller share. `fill` is the whole of it.

VERDICT stack (vertical, swap): the two axes are NOT symmetrical. The row divides for free (a hop is a column); the height has no row to open into, so every band count is a screen that redraws - column count stays 1 at every hop. A band has no url.

VERDICT title slide -> document: the cover keeps its column and gives up the screen - 1920 -> 224 + 1696, one :has() rule, no second render. Its inverse (peek) is the same two pages with the words swapped: document `full`, cover `small`, 1696 + 224.

VERDICT deck: `full` slides hide each other, so swap is free - one url per slide, cold-loadable, Back walks the deck backwards. Arrow keys click the real next/prev anchors, so the keyboard and the mouse take the identical path.

VERDICT uneven: a BASIS is a share. 61.8% / 38.2% measured 1187/733 at 1920 and 2126/1314 at 3440 - the golden section exactly, at both. A third at 20% normalises to about 3.1 : 1.9 : 1; ratios compose, they do not reset per state.

VERDICT quad: a 2x2 menu that becomes a one-column rail when a quadrant opens - asked of the SCREEN's own width, so it stacks at 1920 (menu 531px) and stays a 2x2 at 3440 (951px), which is honest rather than a guessed breakpoint.
VERDICT mix: both axes compose - a cover column beside a column that splits its own height, three areas, and the bands are click targets that open a third column.

FOUND: `hides-nav` is already site-wide. public/page.js carries it and the site root is an active-ancestor on every route, so `.nav` computes display:none everywhere (measured on all 24 urls). The screens did not need the word and do not carry it - noted rather than worked around.

NO SIGHTING of the `width: full` sidebar bug: /imagine/ has no Sidebar, and collapsing the ancestor COLUMNS is what makes a screen full-screen here. Rail 224px -> hidden is the documented behaviour, not the defect.

Scrollbars: nothing on a screen scrolls at any of the three widths - the areas fill exactly. Under 32em of row (400) core pages one column at a time and the row scrolls sideways by design; that is the only overflow measured.
skill: documentation

BUG FOUND AND FIXED (mine): a keydown listener bound in activated() outlives its screen - going DEEPER never deactivates an ancestor, so the deck host kept listening and ArrowRight on slide three walked BACK to slide two (its own `next`). One guard fixes it: `if (location.pathname !== this.url) return`.

CORE QUIRK FOUND: a column marked `default` is BUILT by its host, never routed to, so nothing calls child() on it and the `app` it was adopted with at module scope stays undefined - clicking the deck's first slide at /deck/ threw "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'router')". Screen.go() resolves the app off chain()[0] instead. Not worked around in core; noted for core/Page.

Gestures proven headless at 1600: /deck/ cold-shows slide one, arrows step 1-2-3 and stop, ArrowLeft retreats, a click anywhere advances, Back walks the deck backwards; Divide clicks 2 -> 3 -> 4 columns; the cover click leaves 217 + 1383; the peek opens the cover and hides itself.

Final: 24 urls x 400/1920/3440 = 72 cold loads, ZERO console errors. The one 404 in the log is core's own probe for /imagine/screens/readme/page.js before it falls back to readme.md - the documented md-file mechanism, not a defect.

assign.outcome:
**Eight full-screen experiences at [/imagine/screens/](/imagine/screens/)** - 24 urls, all cold-loadable, 72 headless loads at 400/1920/3440 with zero console errors.

![Divide, four columns at 1920](/framework/ai/2026-08-29/screens-lab/shots/screens-divide-two-three-four-1920.png)

**The finding, in two words.** `/imagine/` is a columns host, so a screen here cannot be a shell - it is the width word `full`, which folds the rail and the index into the crumb strip. One rule in `screens.css` re-tunes `full`'s three tokens to `fill`'s arithmetic, and that single rule is the whole progressive division. After that: **`full` REPLACES** the screen you were on, **`fill` JOINS** it and the screens left divide the row evenly. Every experiment is which word each hop picks.

| | verdict |
|---|---|
| [Divide](/imagine/screens/divide/) | 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 columns, measured 1920/960/640/480 and 3440/1720/1147/860. Nothing re-renders. |
| [Stack](/imagine/screens/stack/) | The axes are NOT symmetrical: the height has no row to open into, so each band count is a screen that redraws, and a band has no url. |
| [Title Slide](/imagine/screens/title/) | 1920 -> 224 + 1696. The cover keeps its column and gives up the screen - one `:has()`, no second render. |
| [Peek](/imagine/screens/read/) | The inverse is the same two pages with the words swapped: 1696 + 224. Whichever page leads keeps the room. |
| [Deck](/imagine/screens/deck/) | `full` slides hide each other, so swap is free: a url per slide, arrows and clicks take the identical path, Back walks it backwards. |
| [Uneven](/imagine/screens/uneven/) | A BASIS is a share: 61.8/38.2 measured 1187/733 at 1920 and 2126/1314 at 3440 - the golden section at both, no grow weights. |
| [Quad](/imagine/screens/quad/) | The 2x2 stacks when its own column runs out (531px at 1920) and stays a 2x2 at 3440 (951px) - the box asked, not a guessed breakpoint. |
| [Mix](/imagine/screens/mix/) | Both axes compose: a cover beside a column that splits its own height, and the bands open a third column. |

**Two bugs found by the gesture probe.** A `keydown` bound in `activated()` outlives its screen - going deeper never deactivates an ancestor, so the deck host kept listening and ArrowRight on slide three walked *back* to two; one guard (`location.pathname !== this.url`) fixes it. And a column marked `default` is BUILT by its host, never routed to, so its `app` stays undefined and `this.app.router` threw - `Screen.go()` resolves it off `chain()[0]` instead. Noted for `core/Page`, not worked around there.

**Also measured:** `hides-nav` is already site-wide (the site root carries it and is an active-ancestor everywhere), so these screens do not need the word. No sighting of the `width: "full"` sidebar bug - `/imagine/` has no Sidebar. Nothing on a screen scrolls at any width; under 32em of row core pages one column at a time and every hop at 400 is a swipe, by design.

**Docs:** [readme](/imagine/screens/readme/) (the verdict table and the traps) - the record, including what was rejected and cut, is in `public/imagine/screens/doc/decisions.md`.

**Left, deliberately:** a vertical spine for the compressed cover (decoration, not information); a url per band (the Router lights one chain, so the url would name the column); re-weighting Uneven to land on exactly 3:2:1 (shares compose instead, ~3.1 : 1.9 : 1); a fifth Divide hop (a quarter is already 480px at 1920).

**Shots:** 27 keepers at 400/1920/3440 in `shots/`.
